homepage.body:
This is a domain from the Brevo all-in-one platform used to send email newsletters as well as transactional emails.

You have probably come across this site because you received an email that was sent by one of our customers. We use this domain for tracking links, hosting images and more. If you have any questions about the content of the email you have received, please contact the person who sent you the email.

Brevo has a Zero Tolerance Policy Towards Spam. If you have received an unsolicited email from one of our users and you would like to unsubscribe and/or report an abuse, we will remove your email address immediately, investigate the sending account and take appropriate measures. You can contact us by email at abuse@brevo.com or by filling the following form. To know more, you can also read our Privacy Policy.
